title: Project Manager (Heartland)
description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description:

As a GuidePoint Security Project Manager you are managing a unique portfolio of security focused Professional Services engagements which directly contribute to our client’s goals and success. This is a remote/virtual position working for a home office with possible travel (up to 15%). This position may also require serving as a client side billable resource for Project Management service delivery.

Role and Responsibilities:

Efficient and effective management of Professional Services projects through the full engagement lifecycle:

Sales handoff

Resourcing

Customer project plan development

Execution management

Project closeout activities

Ensure regular and timely communications to all key stakeholders

Manage project issues and risks to resolution

Maintain and foster internal and external customer relationships, ensuring objectives and statement of work deliverables are met

Plan and manage resources ensuring all projects meet scope and budget expectations

Maintain the OpenAir PSA application for project data

Manage and support internal processes for revenue recognition and customer invoicing

Create and maintain project management methodology and process documentation

Provide Project Management services to GuidePoint customers in a professional service capacity

Other duties as assigned

Required Experience:

Minimum of 3 years of experience in project management

Minimum of 2 years of experience in a consulting services role or similar IT Project Management structure.

Experience in interfacing with information security positions and stakeholders

Experience with Agile methodology

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience

Personal drive and passion for not only personal growth but also the growth of PMO and other GuidePoint Security teams

Advanced project management skills, with demonstrated ability to evaluate project objectives and scope, gain customer understanding, schedule resources, and manage timeline and budget to plan

Ability to manage multiple projects and/or teams simultaneously while maintaining customer satisfaction and financial health

Understanding of a broad range of information security terms and disciplines

Understanding of professional services revenue recognition and invoicing

Demonstrated successful leadership of personnel and technical projects, including the ability to lead, mentor and develop team members

Written communication skills for use in preparing formal deliverables

Verbal communication skills that include the ability to communicate with anyone from a technical resource to the highest level of management

Ability to analyze and solve problems, perform complex tasks and prioritize

Ability to build customer relationships that enhance communications to ensure project success

Demonstrated strong skills in persuasion and negotiation

Advanced use of all Microsoft Office Suite and Microsoft Project, with advanced ability to utilize Microsoft Excel for project reporting

Proficient in Jira, OpenAir and Salesforce, or other Professional Services applications

Experience utilizing remote teleconferencing tools

Evening and weekend hours may be required

Ability to exemplify GuidePoint Security Core Values by having the following:

Desire to “Take Ownership & Complete Our Mission by being a part of the solution, hold themselves accountable, become the expert and take the initiative to get things done

Ability to “Wow Them” by making the customers’ experience a memorable one that keeps them coming back for more

Passion to “Always Challenge Themselves and Have Fun Doing It” by pushing ourselves to take risks and exceed our own expectations.

Desire to follow the “No Jerks” Core Value by treating people with respect and dignity

Preferred Experience:

Standard industry certifications

Advanced computer skills with Mac and Google application experience

Travel Requirements:

Travel up to 15%
Physical Requirements:

Sedentary work

Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day

Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?
GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)

Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)

Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans

12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program

Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance

Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment

Pet Benefit Option

title: Account Executive
description:
Career Category
SalesJob Description

Job Description
Position Summary

Support key hospital ecosystem development, operational sustainability, and access-related activities. Through scientific promotion, key account management, and project support, this role contributes to resolution of suspension and restriction issues, hospital and retail access, and patient accessibility.

Key Responsibilities
1. Key Hospital Support & Key Account Management

Maintain relationships with key hospitals and key accounts, collect hospital needs and market insights, and support implementation of hospital projects.

2. Scientific Promotion & Operational Sustainability Support

Conduct scientific promotion activities in compliance with company policies and support initiatives related to hospital access, reimbursement and pharmacy affairs. Follow up on suspension and restriction issues and hospital access challenges.
3. Hospital & Retail Access Support

Support hospital and retail access projects, facilitate access processes, and maintain project documentation.
4. Reimbursement & Patient Access Support

Collect reimbursement and market information, and support reimbursement-related initiatives and patient access programs.

5. Project Coordination & Cross-functional Collaboration

Support regional projects and collaborate with Marketing, Medical, Commercial, Business and other relevant functions to ensure effective execution.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree or above; healthcare or life science background preferred.

Exceptional candidates may be considered with a college diploma, subject to company approval.

Experience

Minimum 3 years of pharmaceutical industry experience.

Experience in Market Access, business support, or related functions preferred; Key Account Management experience is an advantage.

Extensive experience in compliant scientific promotion, with strong compliance awareness and the ability to conduct in-depth scientific discussions.

Familiar with hospital customer management processes.

Competencies

Compliance awareness, key account management and scientific promotion capability.

Communication and coordination skills.

Execution capability.

Teamwork and collaboration skills.

岗位概述

支持核心医院生态环境建设、安全运营及准入相关工作。通过专业推广、客户管理及项目支持，协助推动停限控问题解决、医院及药店准入以及患者可及性提升。

主要职责

1. 核心医院支持与大客户管理
维护重点医院及大客户合作关系，收集医院需求及市场信息，支持重点医院合作项目开展。
2. 专业推广与安全运营支持

在符合公司合规要求的前提下，开展专业推广活动，支持医院准入、医保及药事相关工作，跟进停限控及院内限制问题解决。
3. 医院及药店准入支持
跟进重点医院及药店准入项目，支持产品准入相关流程推进，维护项目相关信息。
4. 医保与患者可及性支持
收集医保政策及市场环境信息，协助推动医保报销相关工作及患者可及性项目。
5. 项目协调与跨团队协作
支持区域重点项目推进，与市场、医学、商务及业务团队等协同合作，支持项目顺利落地。

任职要求

教育背景

本科及以上学历，医药相关专业优先；

综合条件特别优秀者学历可放宽至大专（需按公司规定完成特批流程）。

工作经验

3年以上医药行业相关工作经验；

具有准入、业务支持或相关经验优先，具有大客户管理经验优先；

具有丰富的专业推广经验和优秀的合规意识，能够开展深度学术沟通；

熟悉医院客户管理流程。

核心能力

合规意识、客户管理及专业推广能力；

沟通协调能力；

执行能力；

团队合作精神。

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst needs 4-7 years of experience, including public accounting or SEC reporting environment
Senior Financial Analyst requires:

Bachelors Degree in Accounting

Masters' Degree in Accounting highly preferred

Oracle and/pr ledger system, FCCS, Wdesk and xbrl experiece preferred

CPA designation required

4-7 years of experience, including public accounting or SEC reporting environment;

Good understanding of US GAAP and competency in preparing financial statement disclosures and performing financial analysis including advanced Microsoft office/Excel required; PeopleSoft and/or ledger system experience required, Hyperion, Wdesk, Kyriba and xbrl experience preferred.

Able to assist other analysts in establishing, modifying, documenting, and implementing reporting methods and control procedures

Able to assist other analysts, consultants and managers with advanced problem solving and complex analysis

A self-starter, detail oriented, self-motivated, self-disciplined and performance driven team player; ability to work and perform tasks with little direction

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Senior Financial Analyst duties:

Review US GAAP disclosures included in Forms 10-Q/K for SEC registrant and its subsidiaries through the execution of companies policies, procedures, and controls

Ability to perform 1st level review of US GAAP and statutory disclosures, including more complex disclosures, and help ensure adherence to reporting protocols by less experienced team members

Interact, communicate and maintain liaison with other functional departments to ensure the quality, accuracy and completeness of the financial reporting disclosures included in SEC and non-SEC filings

Ability to directly oversee the interactions between lower level team members (including offshore resources) and functional areas

Develop and utilize various analytical reports and procedures to assist with the understanding and validation of certain US GAAP and statutory disclosures

Provide guidance and direction to other analyst on usage of analytics to support the completeness and accuracy of our financial reports

Manage and oversee the coordination of the calendar to ensure the timeliness and accurate delivery of financial information including analyzing and reporting of financial activities

Interact with internal and external auditors as needed; help lead and support audit initiatives as required

Recommend process improvements and participate in/lead problem solving sessions and provide functional advice to less experience analysts including offshore resources

Assist in various projects as assigned including the process improvement initiatives related to financial reporting as well as the implementation of new or expanding the usage of certain existing financial reporting tools and other improvement initiatives; lead other analysts in the successful completion of various smaller projects and initiatives
